clearedSpotChecks.check: Tempo v1.19.1-a9d6748: fee charge and refund arithmetic, integer types and casts, and whether a signed, wrapped or truncated value can reach a TIP-20 balance write.
clearedSpotChecks.note: web3_clientVersion on rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz returned tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748 on 2026-11-26. Fetched crates/evm/src/handler/config.rs at a9d6748: settle_transaction converts the price with u128::try_from (line 256-257), maps a negative counter to i64::MAX (260-264), and computes refund = collected.checked_sub(actual_spending) with a fatal error on underflow (269-272). Whatever the counter does, the refund cannot exceed what was collected from the same fee payer, so no value other than the payer's own prepayment moves. The payer comes from envelope.fee_payer() (279-281). The PoolManager is never payer or recipient here.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Celo celo-reth v1.0.10: CIP-64 debit and credit amounts, types and casts, and whether the F-144 wrapped refund can reach a fee-currency balance write that moves funds other than the sender's own prepayment.
clearedSpotChecks.note: forno.celo.org returned reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb. Fetched crates/celo-revm/src/handler.rs at celo/reth-v1.0.10: the debit is (gas_limit as u128).checked_mul(price) (543-547); the credit computes tip and base charge from spent_sub_refunded and refund from remaining + refunded (322-343) and pays caller, beneficiary (fee handler when zero) and fee handler via erc20::credit_gas_fees (298-304, 352-363); it is called from build_execution_result after the frame finished (874-876). Recipients are the sender and fee recipients only, and the credit runs after the main call, so no PoolManager balance or read between sync and settle is affected.

clearedSpotChecks.check: All 21 networks: whether any fee path changes a value the PoolManager reads inside a call: msg.value, a balance read between sync and settle, or gas forwarded to a hook or a token.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read src/PoolManager.sol:279-288 (sync reads balanceOfSelf inside the call), src/PoolManager.sol:349-364 (_settle uses msg.value only when no currency is synced and reverts on nonzero value otherwise, then balance difference and toInt128). grep over src/ outside src/test finds gas() only at src/types/Currency.sol:48 and 73 and src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134, all forwarding all gas, and no gasleft(). No branch depends on a gas amount. The Tempo and Celo handler code read above places debits before and credits after the main frame. The claim holds for the two clients rechecked here; the other clients were not refetched in this verification.
